<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 224.1201, the neutral molecular mass is approximately 224.12 Da. A plausible formula that matches this mass within typical high‑resolution error is C₁₃H₂₀O₃, which gives a monoisotopic mass of 224.141 Da (close to the observed value) and is consistent with the isotopic pattern (dominant M+1 from 13C).</thought>
<final_answer>C13H20O3</final_answer>
